name: tower-clash
description: Tower Clash — a real-time tower-rush PvP game as a Telegram Mini App (original Clash Royale-style clone).

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.start: npm run build --workspace client && npm run start --workspace server
